authorizedSourceRoots.description: Startup read authorization, not proof that logs exist or are readable.

records.description: Counts and digests cover the whole selection; only this page is retained.

sourceIssues.description: Source-level diagnostics can extend beyond the selected dates. No raw messages.

inputRevision.description: Normalized input facts, not raw source bodies or a guarantee of native coverage.

countDelta.description: None means the evidence cannot establish a numeric contribution.

additionalEvidence.description: Up to three further source observations; phases are not independent uses.

delta.description: Available only when scope, normalized evidence and configuration are identical.

confirmedVisibleTokens.description: Native listings do not expose model selection, aliases or prompt budget truncation.

items.description: Same page as inventory items; summary counts are computed before pagination.

noObservedUseDays.description:
Whole elapsed 24-hour periods without a recorded use in the selected window.
Does not establish continuous enablement, loading, or complete observation.

capturedAt.description: Observer cutoff, distinct from individual event times and source dispatch.

sourceCompleteness.description: Completeness of selected source reports, not proof of all native use mechanisms.

oneOf.description: Canonical observed counts remain usable; gaps prevent a complete count.
Inclusive local date since, exclusive local date until, in the recorded timezone.

inputTotal.description: All input, including cache reads and writes. Existing tokens.input stays uncached.

reasoning.description: Subset of output, never an additional billable category.

rawInput.description: Source input including caches; retained for request-level price conditions.

TokenAnalysis.description:
Token subtotals are scoped to the canonical measurements selected by this query.
Existing `tokens` fields remain complete totals; partial observations live here.

totalAnalysis.description:
Independent analysis; immutable historical review items may contain only
the native observations captured when the user made the decision.

ObservedTokenSubtotal.description: An observed subtotal never implies that unavailable records contributed zero.

calculatedRecords.description:
Unavailable native totals use recorded input (including caches) plus output
only for an identified response grain. Reasoning is already in output.

overflowRecords.description: Alternative records excluded by individual or combined safe-integer limits.

cost.description: Present only when every applicable Token category has a known amount.

authorizedProjects.description: Authorized inventory memberships, not proof of joint host loading.

sourceContexts.description: Current physical object keeps each source inventory identity and observation.

diagnostics.description: Bounded current-file diagnostics for directly reviewable static fields.

ContextFootprint.description: A reference catalog row, never proof of model-visible context or historical loading.

historyReadComplete.description: Whether selected source bytes were read completely; independent of attribution gaps.

HookRegistry.description: A current native registry observation; it never proves that a Hook ran.

checks.description: Current rule facts; user decisions never stand in for check outcomes.

applicabilityId.description: Includes relevant dependencies, methods and parameters, but no check cutoff or log revision.

DecisionIdentityBasis.description:
Captured before the first persisted observation; never replaced by later checks.
Missing problem location permits only the exact complete suggestion/content version.

gaps.description: Absent revisions never act as equality wildcards.

RuleMeasurement.description: Values consumed by the rule, including successful measurements and thresholds.

evidence.description: Positions and relationships only; never retain source text or command arguments.

FindingIdentity.description: Problem identity is independent of revisions, thresholds and check timestamps.

relation.description: Scope-bound owner required to prove a declared relation.

advice.description: Positive inspection signals; never fault, resolution, causal waste, or savings claims.

QueryFreshness.description: Internal selector observation; not a request option or source capability.

maximumIncrease.description: Zero means comparable stages had no positive first-to-last change; null means no comparison.

OutcomeStatistics.description: Counts in the captured subset, rather than inferred complete-turn totals.

identityGapRecords.description: Missing-identity observations use physical-record units, unlike canonical group counts.

quantileMethod.description: Linear interpolation at (n-1)p, shared with timing distributions.

groups.description: A task using several models occurs in each model population; counts are not additive.

percentileRank.description: Midrank: (number below + half of ties) / complete sample size.

taskCountContribution.description:
Symmetric arithmetic decomposition: ΔN × (μ0+μ1)/2.
Only available for complete, nonempty populations; never a causal attribution.

perTaskContribution.description: Δμ × (N0+N1)/2; sums with count contribution to attributed token growth.

turnId.description: Exact turn inspection, always bound to a selected thread.

repeatedRequests.description: Identical callable/argument observations inside one exact turn/receiver.

compactionComparison.description: Two observations separated by a compaction marker; not a continuous delta or causal effect.

identityBasis.description: Verified lexical read target or unnormalized source-reported change path.

actualChanges.description: Source write reports do not establish independently observed disk changes.

remaining.description: Contribution of all drivers outside this page, so pages remain reconcilable.

partial.description: Includes source coverage and windows not yet closed at publication time.

tokens.description: Complete analyzed totals only; missing observations never become zero.

cost.description: Complete configured valuations only, with exact decimal subtraction.

tokenRatio.description: No percentage for a zero or unavailable baseline.

partial.description: Conflicting/cyclic ancestry, absent parents or incomplete source coverage.

records.description: Physical safe records, not logical requests, messages or injection counts.

contentVersion.description: Native source records do not retain historical resource versions or measured bodies.

baselineScope.description: Same authorized scope, preceding disjoint dates; absent for unbounded selections.

value.description: Exact decimal representation; no client-side measurement or ratio calculation.

Facets.description: Observed dimensions, not a project registry or a configuration inventory.

discoveredThreadCount.description: Metadata across this snapshot's authorized sources, independent of measurement/date filters.

tokenBasis.description: Basis for maxTokens and peak token scopes/dates.

maxTokens.description: Maximum of bucket analyzed subtotals; not necessarily a complete total.

projectLoads.description: Projects restored from committed facts; pending projects are not zero usage.

initialScan.description: Ephemeral task headers; no completed ledger or coverage is available yet.

endDate.description: Inclusive display date. Scope.until remains exclusive for queries.

matchedTurnCount.description:
Distinct turns with measurements in the current thread-list scope.
None means the matched source records provide no turn association.

lastActivityAt.description: Latest reliable source event time, independent of ordinal and metering.

issueScope.description: Issues and source statuses describe the whole snapshot, not this query window.

queryImpact.description: Snapshot warnings without query-bound attribution cannot prove a scoped defect.

scanComplete.description: All matching indexed positions were visited; source completeness is separate.

window.description: When present, completeness applies only to this requested source window.

oneOf.description: One source-backed activity per conversation, including work without measurements.
Resolve an exact canonical or upstream identity without scanning activity or text.

includeToolOutput.description: Read/search selected tool results on demand; bodies are never indexed.

MessageOrigin.description: Source-backed provenance only; an unclassified user record is not authorization.

readCursor.description: Read-target cursor at a source search match; bound to snapshot, selection and evidence.

eventOffset.description: Exact position in the fixed target partition, not a raw file offset.

observedLogicalBytes.description: Deduplicated observed logical file bytes, never a reclaim estimate.
